user_query: I'm planning a surprise anniversary party for my parents and I need some decoration ideas. Can you suggest some romantic party themes and provide me with a list of nearby party supply stores in Chicago? Additionally, I want to send SMS invitations to their friends and family. Can you help me send SMS messages to their phone numbers? Also, I need to check my account balance to ensure I have enough funds for the party.

TaskList.description: Research and suggest romantic party themes suitable for an anniversary celebration.
Find nearby party supply stores in Chicago that can provide the necessary decoration items.
Collect friends and family phone numbers for sending SMS invitations.
Send SMS invitations to the gathered phone numbers.
Check account balance to ensure there are sufficient funds for the party expenses.
